lead_measurement_agrees_with_worker_081.cross_check: Lead measured the same ratios at dr=0.1: lffd 3.195203e-04/4.159e-04 = 0.768, cnfd 9.405701e-04/4.162e-04 = 2.260, cnfem 1.171507e-04/4.155e-04 = 0.282. Worker-081 reported 0.77 / 2.26 / 0.28. The two measurements were made independently and agree to the quoted precision.

f1_resolution.disposition_chosen: REPLACE THE EVIDENCE, DO NOT AMEND THE PROTOCOL
why_not_a_protocol_rev_4: Section 3.4 as written is CORRECT and is satisfied by the new certification study: spatial order measured at a fixed small dt, with dt-proportional-to-h runs reported as mixed-order and never quoted as spatial. The defect was in the evidence, not the rule.

Amending the protocol at this moment would supersede the standing rev-3 accept and re-open the moving-target cycle the audit group has just declared a blocking pattern (audit-direction-freeze-enforce-final-20260912T0027: 8 formulation revisions in ~6 minutes, two reviewers invalidated).
The stricter reading of the existing protocol is satisfied without any text change, so no permission needs to be granted.
f1_resolution.what_would_have_falsified_this_response: If the protocol-exact fixed-dt ladder had NOT reproduced order 2 within the band, the claim would have had to be withdrawn rather than re-based. It did reproduce: see certified_order_claim.

temporal_subdominance_control.method: fixed dr in {0.2, 0.05}, dt = cfl*dr / 2^k for k = 0..5; the dt -> 0 limit is the spatial plateau e_spatial(h); dt = cfl*dr is the certified ladder's point
temporal_subdominance_control.pre_stated_rule: constant-CFL admissible as spatial iff |p_fixed_dt - p_cfl| <= 0.25 AND temporal excess at dr=0.2 <= 0.05

result.reading: lffd and cnfem errors INCREASE as dt is refined (negative excess) and cnfd's decreases by 126%; all three constant-CFL ladders are mixed-order, two of them by cancellation. Rule (b) fails, so the constant-CFL ladder is not admissible as spatial evidence. Thresholds were fixed before the numbers were seen and were not moved.

error_field_structure_check.question: Three different spatial discretisations showed fixed-dt plateaus agreeing to 4 significant figures. Is that each scheme's own truncation error, or one shared error on an axis this replication does not vary?

result.reading: Strongly NEGATIVE cnfd-vs-cnfem correlation, exactly as predicted by the leading phase-error coefficients: central 3-point FD is -1/12 (kh)^2, P1 consistent-mass FEM is +1/12 (kh)^2 -- equal magnitude, opposite sign. lffd-vs-cnfd is +0.9999999966 because they share the spatial stencil and differ only in time integration. The near-identical norms are the |+-1/12| coincidence, NOT a shared-error artifact.

error_field_structure_check.consequence: Independent corroboration that each scheme's own spatial truncation error dominates the fixed-dt plateau, so the cross-scheme replication is not three views of one shared error.

canonical_family_temporal_control.why: The canonical artifact numerics/tests/flat_wave.py also steps with dt = t_end/ceil(t_end/(cfl*h)), i.e. also constant CFL, so the same question had to be asked of the primary evidence. The file was imported read-only and NOT edited.
canonical_family_temporal_control.reading: All three canonical studies ARE spatial-dominated at their declared cfl, because they use classical RK4 (4th-order in time), so dt ~ h gives temporal error ~h^4, negligible against h^2 spatial error. Contrast the replication family, whose CN/leapfrog integrators are only 2nd-order in time, so dt ~ h gives temporal error of the SAME order as the spatial error. This is why the canonical evidence survives F1 and the replication evidence did not.

certified_order_claim.statement: For the flat-space spherical scalar-wave calibration on the pinned configuration (outgoing Gaussian pulse, psi = r*phi reduction, Dirichlet walls at r=0 and r=30, t_end=6, L2-integral error norm), the spatial discretisation is second order: at FOUR rungs (dr = 0.2/0.1/0.05/0.025) with dt FIXED at 1e-4 on every rung -- exactly the study protocol section 3.4 prescribes -- each of three methodologically independent schemes fits p = 2.0000 within |p - 2| <= 0.3, and the three agree with each other to 8.0e-05, 3000x inside the R5 bound.
which_schemes_order_is_certified: lffd -- independent reference-family control: explicit leapfrog time integration + 3-point central finite differences.
cnfd -- independent scheme 1: implicit Crank-Nicolson (trapezoidal) time integration + 3-point central finite differences.
cnfem -- independent scheme 2: implicit Crank-Nicolson time integration + consistent-mass P1 finite elements.
independence_axes: time integration: explicit symplectic leapfrog vs implicit trapezoidal CN
spatial discretisation: finite differences vs consistent-mass P1 FEM (leading phase errors -1/12 and +1/12, opposite sign)
energy functional: leapfrog staggered vs average-acceleration invariant vs P1-FEM discrete energy
certified_order_claim.norm: L2 integral; R5a requires the norm to be named
certified_order_claim.fit_method: log-log least squares over all four rungs; delta = max(pair-spread half-range, LS slope standard error)

replication_tolerance_claim.rule: R5: agree iff |p_A - p_B| <= max(0.25, sqrt(delta_A^2 + delta_B^2))
replication_tolerance_claim.note: The R5 floor of 0.25 was not lowered; the measured spread is 3000x inside it. The much looser floor is retained deliberately: it was declared before the data and exists to prevent over-tight claims from short log-log fits.

relabelled_mixed_order_control.status: MIXED-ORDER corroborating control -- NOT a spatial claim
relabelled_mixed_order_control.why_retained: It remains the controller-verified 3-rung run's 4-rung extension and shows the same qualitative conclusion under a different time-step policy; after F1/F1' it may only be quoted as mixed-order.

certified_order_claim.three_rung_vs_four_rung: The 3-rung controller run (#6542db93) and its 4-rung constant-CFL extension are supporting mixed-order evidence only. The certified fit is the fixed-dt = 1e-4 four-rung study.

invariant_functional.rule: R1/R2: each scheme is judged on its OWN declared structural discrete functional; the harness leapfrog staggered energy is a labelled cross-functional diagnostic only (R4), never a scheme-independent conservation gate.

lffd.own_energy_kind: leapfrog staggered energy (identical to the harness functional)

cnfem.formula: 1/2 V^T M V + 1/4 psi_new^T K psi_new + 1/4 psi_old^T K psi_old

invariant_functional.acceptance_text_demotion: The harness invariant PASS with drift_tol = 1e-6 bounds the LEAPFROG functional, not any solver's own invariant. Retained only as a labelled cross-check (harness_leapfrog_energy_drift).
invariant_functional.f7_status: not triggered -- no non-leapfrog scheme has harness-functional drift <= its own drift (ratios 5.95e6 cnfd, 4.15e5 cnfem).

cnfd_drift_threshold_justification.adjudication_item: N0_adjudication.md item 5: the cnfd own-energy self-check at drift 6.6e-8 needs a principled threshold justification, not a threshold moved to make it pass.
cnfd_drift_threshold_justification.resolution: The 6.6e-8 figure is NOT cnfd's own-energy drift. It is the leapfrog staggered energy evaluated on a Crank-Nicolson trajectory -- a cross-functional mismatch diagnostic (R4).
cnfd_drift_threshold_justification.why_the_old_threshold_was_not_admissible: A fixed 1e-8 threshold on the leapfrog functional is resolution-arbitrary: with the scheme unchanged, cnfd FAILS at dr = 0.05 and PASSES at dr = 0.025. A pass/fail that flips under one refinement is not a property of the scheme. Replaced by the functional-aware, resolution-aware R1-R4 rules. No threshold was relaxed: drift_tol = 1e-6 is unchanged and still applied as a labelled cross-check.

cnfem_triage.defect: CrankNicolsonFEM assembled the recurrence as (M + cK) psi^{n+1} = 2 M psi^n - (M - cK) psi^{n-1}, c = dt^2/2; the trapezoidal rule requires -(M + cK) psi^{n-1} on the right-hand side.
cnfem_triage.disposition: retained, not deleted; no threshold relaxed
cnfem_triage.effect_pre_fix: one amplification root has |rho| > 1 per generalized eigenmode; order -0.0773, harness drift 1.0e+01, failing self-test in the pinned pre-fix run 7adab492
cnfem_triage.fix: one line: use B = M + cK on the right-hand side
cnfem_triage.f5_status: not triggered -- the corrected RHS was the cause; the scheme reproduces cleanly at the frozen hash and certifies at fixed dt.
